title: The reflection in the bay
logline: A tide pool on the flats, still, and in it upside down a man's face looking down — blurred by a ripple the page draws over the mouth. The nearest the sequence comes to a face, and it's in water, and it's moving.

panels.composition: Close on a still tide pool in the mud reflecting, upside down, a graying man's face looking down into it, a single ripple crossing the reflection at the mouth, the sky's gray around it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a still tide pool in mud reflecting a graying man's face looking down upside down with a single ripple crossing the reflection at the mouth, gray sky in the water around it, no words
image.notes: A face, in water, rippled at the mouth. The sequence's closest.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A face in a pool, rippled where it would speak.
